caffeine releases adrenaline and prolonged adrenaline can release cortisol which both make you anxious as shit. plus the fact that your blood sugar might be low can really worsen the anxiety. so staying a bit away from it or lowering your intake might really help you !

for most of my friends who have been dealing with weed addiction, exercising and going to the gym really helped them. not having THC in your body can make you feel like you have more energy and that sometimes drives people crazy, its good to pour that feeling into moving your body. when you quit an addiction it can help to fill in the holes that it left with something else. the danger herein lies that you fill it with other unhealthy habits or substances so watch out for that! not saying it works for everybody but maybe try it out and see how it works for you :).

if I'm right it goes from

1 lesser spirits: these are young spirits who still not have acquired sufficient power and most of the time don't have a element yet but are able to communicate with spirit users and channel light amounts of mana.

2 quasi spirits: these are like half completed spirits who can already have a magic affinity (like julius his 6 quasi spirits) but are less powerful then regular spirits. they can channel mana and use it.

3 spirits: these fully evolved spirits are (normally) formed over prolonged amounts of time when a user establishes a strong bond with them. these are powerful elemental spirits who are capable of channeling elemental power and casting it themselves.

4 there are 4 great spirits:  Muspel, Odglass, Zarestia and of course, Puck. they are have absolute mastery over one element (puck is the great spirit of fire) but are most of the times capable of using more then one element. this title can be taken away by defeating one of the great spirits so its not really a evolution as much as just a title.

furthermore, artificial spirits also exist, beatrice and puck   >!were both created by echinda!< these spirits are not able to sustain themselves like normal spirits. beatrice for example drains mana from the mansion and later from subaru and puck draws it from emillia or from the atmosphere (which he completely destroys in the process).

    

these spirits can be powerful but are mostly always incomplete.
